title: Long Haul — Flights for Sleep
description: Real long-haul flights. Real flight numbers. Real routes. Captain announcements, cabin ambiance, flight map. Economy to first class. The sky at 3am.
concept: Real flight data + real airline style + flight map animation. Each video is a specific flight on a specific airline. The viewer is on the plane. The captain speaks. The map moves. The engine hums. You fall asleep somewhere over the Atlantic.

british_airways.voice_style: Warm, British, professional. 'Good evening, ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking'
british_airways.signature: Union Jack on tail, navy blue seats, warm lighting

ryanair.voice_style: Direct, efficient, Irish. 'Attention passengers, this is your first officer speaking'
ryanair.signature: Blue/yellow seats, tight pitch, no frills
ryanair.announcement_style: Brief, no-nonsense, get to the point

japan_airlines.voice_style: Polite, melodic, formal Japanese with English announcements
japan_airlines.signature: Red crane logo, grey seats, meticulous service

emirates.signature: Gold/cream interiors, entertainment system, luxury feel

economy.visual: Tight cabin, blue seats, small seat-back screen with flight map
economy.vibe: The long night flight. You fell asleep before takeoff and woke up over the ocean.

business.visual: Wider seats, personal screen, dimmed cabin, ambient lighting
business.ambiance: Quieter cabin, champagne clinking, subdued conversations
business.vibe: The premium experience. The seat reclines fully. The screen is large. The captain knows your name.

first.visual: Private suite, closing doors, personal minibar, large screen
first.ambiance: Near silence, occasional service sounds, the most exclusive hum
first.vibe: The pinnacle. A room in the sky. The flight map fills your private screen. The captain whispers.
